# Function to create a randomized complete block design
create_rcbd <- function(num_treatments, num_blocks) {
# Create an empty matrix to store the design
design <- matrix(NA, nrow = num_treatments * num_blocks, ncol = 2)
colnames(design) <- c("Treatment", "Block")
# Assign treatments and blocks
for (i in 1:num_blocks) {
block_start <- (i - 1) * num_treatments + 1
block_end <- block_start + num_treatments - 1
# Randomly assign treatments within the block
treatments <- sample(rep(1:num_treatments, each = 1), num_treatments)
# Assign treatments and blocks to the matrix
design[block_start:block_end, 1] <- treatments
design[block_start:block_end, 2] <- i
}
return(design)
}
# Set the number of treatments and blocks
num_treatments <- 2  # Control and Heat
num_blocks <- 8
# Create the randomized complete block design
rcbd_design <- create_rcbd(num_treatments, num_blocks)
# Print the design
print(rcbd_design)
# Define the total number of plots
total_plots <- 48
# Number of columns (assuming 8 columns, 6 plots per column)
n_columns <- 8
plots_per_column <- total_plots / n_columns
# Generate sequences for each column
column_sequences <- lapply(1:n_columns, function(i) seq(i, total_plots, by=n_columns))
# Initialize empty lists to store the randomized assignments
control_plots <- list()
heat_plots <- list()
set.seed(123)  # Set seed for reproducibility
# Randomly assign 3 control and 3 heat treatment plots to each column
for (i in 1:n_columns) {
column <- column_sequences[[i]]
# Randomly sample 3 plots for control and 3 for heat treatment
control_plots[[i]] <- sample(column, 3)
heat_plots[[i]] <- setdiff(column, control_plots[[i]])
}
# Combine the results into a data frame
design <- data.frame(
Column = rep(1:n_columns, each=plots_per_column),
Plot = unlist(column_sequences),
Treatment = rep(NA, total_plots)
)
# Assign treatments based on the randomized samples
for (i in 1:n_columns) {
design$Treatment[design$Plot %in% control_plots[[i]]] <- "Control"
design$Treatment[design$Plot %in% heat_plots[[i]]] <- "Heat"
}
# View the design
print(design)

}
